signal.description: Reports surfaced of a Netflix $72B all-cash bid for WBD's studio and streaming assets, suggesting a potential second approach after the Paramount-Skydance deal.

judgment.assessment: A $72B all-cash bid would represent the largest streaming M&A transaction in history. If genuine, it restructures the entire post-consolidation competitive landscape — Disney, Amazon, and Apple must all reassess their content and distribution strategies.

action.directive: WATCH whether the reported Netflix $72B all-cash bid for WBD's studio and streaming assets reflects a genuine second approach.

falsifier.condition: Netflix publicly denies the bid within 14 days, or no regulatory filing or credible second source confirms the approach within 30 days of the initial report.
